title: Small-Molecule Inhibitors of TIPE3 Protein Identified through Deep Learning Suppress Cancer Cell Growth In Vitro.
summary: Three selected compounds reduced cancer-cell growth; two showed expression-associated selectivity. Cellular activity does not establish direct target engagement or clinical efficacy.
ai_technology: DFCNN dense neural network and DeepBindBC
